title: March 6, 2026
summary: SCIM provisioning (Enterprise): manage users directly from your identity provider via SCIM 2.0, with automated provisioning/deprovisioning, real-time name and email sync, IdP group mapping to roles and Teams, and three sync modes. Data Retention v1.5 (Enterprise): named retention rules for Recordings or Candidates, a preset or custom timeframe, a deletion type, a validation preview before activation, a 24-hour buffer, and a full audit trail. Route approvals to specific admins: a new governance setting locks the approver dropdown to the account owner or chosen admins across every request type. Livestream status, visible everywhere: livestream and observer bot status now shows in the Interview room, participant table, slideout, and dashboard, with on-demand bot resend and pre-flight checks for Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Webex. body_markdown:
### SCIM provisioning


*Enterprise*


Enterprise IT teams can now manage Great Question users directly from their identity provider through SCIM 2.0, automating provisioning, deprovisioning, and role management. Users are provisioned and deprovisioned automatically as your IdP changes, with name and email synced in real time. Push IdP groups to map to Great Question roles and Teams, with three sync modes (off, initial only, full sync). Configure it all at Settings → Governance → Provisioning, including bearer tokens, default roles, and IdP-managed roles and teams.


### Data Retention v1.5


*Enterprise*


Take full control of your data retention policy with named rules for Recordings or Candidates, a preset or custom timeframe, and a deletion type. Rules run daily, with a validation step that shows exactly what will be deleted before activation and a 24-hour buffer before anything irreversible happens. Every rule creation, edit, status change, and deletion is recorded in a full audit trail, and rules can be paused or retired without losing that history.


### Route approvals to specific admins


A new governance setting lets you route all approval requests to the account owner or a set of individual admins. When enabled, the approver dropdown is locked to that list across every request type, study publish, study funding, feature requests, and team requests.


### Livestream status, visible everywhere


Livestream and observer bot status now shows up wherever you need it — the Interview room, participant table, slideout, and dashboard, so most issues no longer require a support ticket. You can resend the bot on demand from the Interview room, and pre-flight checks validate the URL, platform support, and meeting settings for Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Webex ahead of time, with proactive email notifications if something's wrong.
